# Set registry value (`registry.set`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Advanced · **Runs as:** depends on the fields (see below) · **Revertible:** yes

Writes a registry value. Use this for any Windows setting that has no dedicated action.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | text | yes |  | Registry key starting with HKCU\ (your settings) or HKLM\ (machine settings, machine automations only). Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `name` | text | no |  | Value name. Leave empty for the key's default value. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `value` | text | yes |  | The data. Numbers for dword/qword; separate multi_string items with \|. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `kind` | one of: `string`, `expand_string`, `dword`, `qword`, `multi_string` | no | `string` | Value type. |
| `broadcast` | true / false | no | `false` | Tell running apps that settings changed (WM_SETTINGCHANGE). Some settings need this to apply without signing out. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: registry.set
    key: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced
    name: HideFileExt
    value: "0"
    kind: dword
    broadcast: true
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `key` and `name` are the same.

## Notes

When reverted, a value that did not exist before is deleted again. Wrong registry edits can break Windows; prefer a dedicated action when one exists.
